label: early original-phase token right after n (t=2/3), esp. x n _ or n u
explanation: Very sparse feature (~0.05% of sequences). It fires almost only in the original phase at step 2 or 3 (99.9% of mass), and only when the previous input was n (99.6% of mass). Activations are strongest when the current input is u (58% of mass) or the token two back was x, i.e. prefixes like h x n u, 3 x n u, h n u. The first token also matters: h, x and 3 as the first token raise both the firing rate and the magnitude (the top example, h x n u, reaches the max). It does not fire in the delimiter or copy phases, or at t>=4. Precision is low: most prev=n, t=2/3 steps (even h n e, h n z) stay inactive, so the feature is conditioned on specific combinations of the first few tokens that the predicate only approximates. Adding first-token lists raises dev F1 to about 0.37 but overfits.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 21 cues. Raise it: t=3 & prev_tok=n (+3.71), prev_tok=n (+3.01), prev2_tok=x (+2.59), prev2_tok=n (+2.18), prev3_tok=h (+2.15), t=2 & prev_tok=n (+1.92). Lower it: orig_idx=-1 (-1.91).
